milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate near the dark oak door and face it to demonstrate they have located it. The door is at spawn-relative position (7, 1, 3), placed in the south-facing wall of a stone brick building ~7.6 blocks from spawn. max_distance=16 allows detection from a wide range (the door is visible from spawn per sandbox preview), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the door rather than away from it.
